title: GAP Waiver Plus 150 Starting Balance: Capitalized Days of a Long First Period
content:
For GAP Waiver Addenda Plus 150 claims, some days of the first payment period of the Retail Installment Contracts contract are capitalized into the Plus starting balance. That period runs from the contract date to the first payment date.

**Rule.**

- When that first period runs more than 50 days, 20 days are capitalized.
- When it runs 32 to 50 days, the days beyond 30 are capitalized.
- When it runs 31 days or fewer, none are capitalized.

The first-period days capitalized add to the opening principal. The amount added is the amount financed times the original annual percentage rate divided by 100, times those days, divided by 365, rounded half-up to the cent.

**Input, judgement, output**

| First period | Judgement | Days capitalized |
|---|---|---|
| 58 days | more than 50 | 20 |
| 50 days | 32 to 50 | 20 |
| 40 days | 32 to 50 | 10 |
| 32 days | 32 to 50 | 2 |
| 31 days | 31 or fewer | 0 |

*Hypothetical case.* On 16500.00 financed at 19.5 percent, 20 capitalized days add 176.30 to the opening principal.
